Seasonal Weed Sprayer
Work includes identifying and controlling noxious weeds throughout the county using herbicide application equipment, roadside spraying, field inspections, equipment operation/maintenance, and general weed control activities.

Emergency Management Coordinator
The position leads countywide preparedness, mitigation, response, and recovery efforts; and provides timely public information during emergencies and disasters.
